mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsExperienceListMapper : 이음-e극복경험사례(콤보)*/ CMMNS_CD_ID /* 공통코드아이디 */ , CMMNS_CD_VALUE /* 공통코드값 */ , UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE /* 상위공통코드값 */ , CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM /* 공통코드값명 */ FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = #{CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD} /* 이음-e콤보값 */
SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsExperienceListMapper : 이음-e극복경험사례*/ count(*) FROM AYE240 WHERE 1=1

/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsExperienceListMapper : 이음-e극복경험사례(조회)*/
SELECT AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /*색인일련번호*/ , AA.CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD /*이음극복경험카테고리구분코드*/ , SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(AA.BBSCTT_DTL_CN, CHR(10), ''), '<[^>]*>|\&([^;])*;' , ''), 0, 20) AS BBSCTT_DTL_CN /*게시글상세내용*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일시*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일시*/ , BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목*/ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS NAME FROM AYE240 AS AA , SAC100 AS BB WHERE 1=1
AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD' AND BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD
AND CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD LIKE '%'||#{CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD}||'%'
AND INDEX_SN LIKE '%'||#{INDEX_SN}||'%'
AND (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) LIKE '%'|| #{NAME} ||'%'
AND BBSCTT_DTL_CN LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_DTL_CN}||'%'
ORDER BY AA.INDEX_SN DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsExperienceListMapper : 이음-e극복경험사례(상세)*/ AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /*색인일련번호*/ , AA.CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD /*이음극복경험카테고리구분코드*/ , AA.BBSCTT_DTL_CN AS BBSCTT_DTL_CN /*게시글상세내용*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록자아이디*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일시*/ , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정자아이디*/ , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일시*/ , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT FROM AYE240 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
mapper.insert:
SELECT AYE240_SQ01.CURRVAL AS INDEX_SN FROM DUAL
/* AYE240 */ INSERT INTO AYE240 (/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsExperienceListMapper : 이음-e극복경험사례(등롥)*/ INDEX_SN /*색인일련번호*/ , CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD /*이음극복경험카테고리구분코드*/ , BBSCTT_DTL_CN /*게시글상세내용*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록자아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일시*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정자아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일시*/ , DEL_YN ) VALUES( AYE240_SQ01.NEXTVAL /*색인일련번호*/ , #{CNCT_SBJGAT_EXPRNC_CTGRYB_SE_CD} /*이음극복경험카테고리구분코드*/ , #{BBSCTT_DTL_CN} /*게시글상세내용*/ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /*최초등록자아이디*/ , #{FRST_REG_DT} /*최초등록일시*/ , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정자아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최종수정일시*/ , 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE AYE240 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsExperienceListMapper : 이음-e극복경험사례(수정)*/ BBSCTT_DTL_CN = #{BBSCTT_DTL_CN} /* 게시글내용 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN} /*게시글고유번호*/

UPDATE AYE240 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsExperienceListMapper : 이음-e극복경험사례(삭제)*/ DEL_YN = 'Y' /*삭제여부*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN__origin} /*게시글고유번호*/
